about_the_game:
ASYMMETRIC SOCIAL PARTY GAME

Mail it to the King! is a multiplayer party game designed for 3 to 8 players.
Perfect for game nights with friends or family, it also works great as an icebreaker at social gatherings!

One player takes the role of the King, while the others play as Courtiers.

THE COURTIER ROLE: SEND LETTERS TO YOUR KING

As a Courtier, your job is to answer personal questions about the King, like:
“What does the King think about camping?”
Your answer is then sent to the King, who decides whether they like it.
Rely on your knowledge of the King… or your imagination. It’s up to you to find the best strategy to win their favor!

THE KING ROLE: JUDGES THE ANSWERS

As the King, you judge the Courtiers’ answers. They're all competing to earn your approval.
This is your court. It's about you. It's personal.
Reward the funniest, crown the most loyal, and punish those who completely miss the mark!

DETHRONE THE KING

The first player to reach the throne becomes the new King!

PLAY IT ONLINE OR ON THE COUCH

Quick and easy to set up, Mail it to the King! is perfect for livening up any game night with friends or family.

Play it locally on the couch, using your phone or tablet as a controller. Or play it online with only one copy required (your friends can use the free friend pass).

KEY FEATURES

  • Play it locally (on your phone or your tablet) or online

  • Only one copy of the game needed

  • Supports 3 to 8 players

  • Over 1,000 questions!

  • Family-friendly content

  • 8 playable characters

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10+
  • Processor: 2.66 Ghz Core 2 Duo or Greater
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce 500+ / Radeon 5000+ or Greater
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10+
  • Processor: 2.33 GHz Quad Core or Greater
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce 600+ / Radeon 6000+
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection

short_description: A multiplayer trivia game where the questions are about you! Be the King and judge your friends' answers about yourself. Or be a Courtier, guess their quirks, tastes, and dreams. Win favor, climb the ranks, become the new King. 3-8 players, online or local.
supported_languages: English, French, Spanish - Spain, German, Portuguese - Brazil, Italian
